title: Preface
text:
Karibu Jiongeze
Jiongeze means grow yourself, improve yourself, and keep moving forward.
Everyone starts somewhere.
Some people begin with experience.
Some begin with ideas.
Some begin with curiosity.
Some begin with nothing more than a willingness to learn.
Jiongeze was created to help learners move from knowledge to opportunity through small steps, practical activities, creativity, and community action.

title: Preface
text:

Kila hatua ndogo leo, ni kesho bora.
Every small step today creates a better tomorrow.

title: Computer Confidence
text:
Getting Comfortable with Computers
Many people think:
“Computers are difficult.”
“What if I break something?”
“What if I press the wrong button?”
These feelings are normal.
Every person who uses a computer today once started as a beginner.
Computers are tools that become easier through practice.

title: Computer Confidence
text:
Note



You do not need to know everything.
You only need to begin.

title: Computer Confidence

A computer is a tool that helps people:

Write information
Store files
Create documents
Search for information
Communicate
Learn new things

Computers help us work, learn, create, and solve problems.

Displays information.

Used for typing.

Used for clicking and selecting.

Turns the computer on or off.

Connect devices.

Learning to Type
The keyboard helps us communicate with computers.

You do not need to type fast at the beginning.

Tip

Used to type words.


Numbers
Used to type numbers and calculations.


Space Bar
Creates spaces between words.


Enter Key
Moves to a new line or confirms actions.


Backspace Key
Deletes text behind the cursor.


Shift Key
Helps create capital letters and symbols.

Keeping Things Organized

Computers work the same way.
Files and folders help us organize information.

A video

title: Understanding Flyers

One common method is a flyer.
A flyer is a printed or digital page used to share information with others.
Flyers help people learn about:

Businesses

Note

The main message.


Images
Pictures that help explain information.


Main Information
Important details people should know.


Contact Information

title: Journey: Hamis Idd
text:
Small Steps Can Create Change
Everyone begins somewhere.
Some people start with skills.
Some start with opportunities.
Some start with curiosity.
